name: Richard J. Dircks
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in New York, New York
education: University of Southern California Gould School of Law
about: A partner at Getnick Law in New York City, New York, Richard J. Dircks is dedicated to providing top-quality representation in the realm of business and corporate law to a diverse clientele. He is highly adept at navigating complex legal landscapes, providing strategic guidance on matters ranging from transactional agreements to intricate corporate governance issues. His legal knowledge encompasses business litigation, ensuring that clients receive diligent and effective advocacy in all legal proceedings.

Mr. Dircks' academic background provides a strong foundation for his legal acumen. He completed his undergraduate studies in 1993, earning a Bachelor of Science degree from Cornell University. Further enhancing his business insight, he obtained a Master of Business Administration from The Peter J. Tobin College of Business at St. John's University. He then pursued his legal education at the University of Southern California Gould School of Law and received his Juris Doctor in 1996.

A stalwart advocate for his clients, Mr. Dircks emphasizes personalized attention, meticulous focus and enthusiastic zeal to see their legal woes resolved. For his many contributions, he has been rated “Very Good” on Avvo.

Admitted to practice before the United States District Courts for the Eastern and Southern Districts of New York, Mr. Dircks is well-prepared to represent clients in federal legal matters within these jurisdictions. His commitment to the legal profession is further underscored by his active memberships in several prestigious legal organizations, including the American Bar Association, the New York State Bar Association and the New York City Bar Association. These affiliations highlight his dedication to upholding the highest standards of legal practice and staying abreast of developments within the legal community.
honors: Nominee-Finalist, Public Justice Foundation, Trial Lawyer of the Year Award, 2011 (member of legal team)
Nominated for “Trial Lawyer of the Year” recognition in connection with a $750 million case against GlaxoSmithKline
